job: Put things one above another with even space.
purpose: A vertical flex box. Space comes from data-gap on the parent (steps 0 to 24); data-align sets how children line up across it. It sets no width or height. Stacks, rows and grids nest freely.
useWhen: Children sit one above another: a heading, text and a button.
Fields or cards in a column need one consistent gap.

avoidWhen.when: Children form equal columns that fill the width.
A form needs its measure and rows.
You are about to write a margin or a pixel gap.
avoidWhen.instead: Set data-gap on the stack instead.

variants.useWhen: Children keep their own width and sit at the start.
Children are centred across the stack.
